### 1 — Scene
A light meal of mixed leafy salad, fresh fruit, and a few roasted potato pieces.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: mixed salad leaves, cantaloupe, strawberries, blueberries, and roasted potatoes. The leaves appear lightly glossy; I estimate a small amount of oil-based dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy

| Cantaloupe | 11% | 58 × 2.5 = 146 ml | 0.65 | 95 g | 34 | 32 kcal |
| Strawberries | 5% | 27 × 2 = 53 ml | 0.60 | 32 g | 32 | 10 kcal |

| Dressing oil, estimated | Overlapping | Thin film ≈ 3.3 ml | 0.92 | 3 g | 884 | 27 kcal |

The potato energy density includes roasting oil; the separate dressing estimate applies only to the salad.

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 265 g and 203 kcal** is plausible for the visible fruit, small potato portion, and airy leafy salad. Dressing quantity and potato oil content are the main uncertainties.
